reviewNotes: HOLD. Current Smart lifecycle material confirms 365-day loaded-value validity and a 180-day reload grace after balance reaches zero, but foreign-tourist SIM registrations are only valid for 30 days unless an approved visa extension is supplied. Other-visa foreign nationals are not subject to that 30-day cap. No fixed annual keep-alive cost or current foreign-user end-to-end reproduction is inferred.

events.outcome: Smart ordinary prepaid lifecycle remains 365 days for loaded value plus a 180-day reload grace after balance reaches zero, but foreign tourists face a separate 30-day SIM-registration validity cap unless an approved visa extension is supplied. The legacy route is therefore not treated as a generally available long-term foreign-user route.

data.acquisitionSummary: Smart currently offers a P99 prepaid eSIM. Registration is mandatory. Foreign tourists receive only 30 days of SIM validity unless they submit an approved visa extension; foreign nationals with other visa types can acquire without that temporary 30-day cap.

keep.action: Loaded prepaid value must be used within 365 days. If the balance reaches zero, reload within 180 days to avoid disconnection. These are separate lifecycle clocks; no fixed minimum annual retention cost is established here.

data.chinaActivation: Remote/China-first registration and activation are not established by current provider material.
data.kyc: SIM registration is mandatory. Foreign tourists are capped at 30 days unless an approved visa extension is supplied; foreign nationals holding other visa types are not subject to that temporary 30-day validity period.
data.payment: Smart supports prepaid loading; the minimum universally available reload amount and foreign-card acceptance are not established here.
data.holdReason: Foreign-tourist registrations are automatically deactivated after 30 days unless an approved visa extension is supplied. Long-term eligibility exists for other visa categories, but no current foreign-user end-to-end reproduction is captured.
data.tariffSummary: P99 prepaid eSIM; ordinary prepaid value is valid 365 days, with a separate 180-day reload grace after balance reaches zero.
guideSteps: Register the SIM under the correct foreign-national eligibility category.
Track loaded-value expiry separately from the zero-balance reload grace.
Do not treat a tourist-registered SIM as a long-term route without an approved visa extension.
